sketch.name: AgingBuckets
sketch.description: Receivables, payables or exposure aging: one bar per bucket (Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+) with amount, count and share of total, a header with the total and the past-due total and percentage, and bars that run from neutral to warning to negative.
sketch.html: Bucket Amount Count % of total

props.name: title
props.description: The title shown in the header.

props.name: unit
props.description: Currency or unit shown before amounts, such as $ or gal.

props.name: selected
props.description: Name of the selected bucket; empty for none.

props.name: buckets
props.description: The buckets in order, Current first: { bucket, amount, count }.

sketch.notes: Simple control: one class AgingBuckets plus a plain record AgingBucket (Bucket, Amount, Count), event args for bucketSelected, client class and theme mixin. Docked in a GridBoard widget, no card chrome, fluid 300x200 to 1000x500; below ~420px the count column drops. Bars scale to the largest bucket; Past due = sum of all buckets but the first.
